name: Clean Energy Scheme with Missing Critical Disbursement Attribute
question: What are the subsidy amount, applicant eligibility, and disbursement timeline for the Clean Energy Startup scheme?

sources.title: Ministry Guidelines on Clean Energy Startup Capital Support 2026
sources.cleanedText: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy notification issued 2026-01-10. Approved capital grant provides financial assistance up to Rs 25,00,000 for early stage clean technology ventures. Eligibility criteria requires DPIIT recognition and registered office in India. Applications must be submitted through the National Single Window Portal.

sources.title: Industry Review: Renewable Energy Capital Subsidies
sources.cleanedText: Published on 15 February 2026. The national clean tech initiative offers funding of Rs 25 lakh to verified early stage green tech startups. The official portal is the National Single Window Portal.
